# Hashed denylist for scripts/check-name-hygiene.py.
# Format: "<id> <mode> <sha256(salt + lower-case token)>"; mode x = whole token, p = token prefix.
# Plain values are deliberately not stored in the repo. To add an entry, compute
#   printf %s "$SALT$TOKEN" | sha256sum
# locally and append it with the next free id; reviewers judge it by the PR description, not by this file.
